chapter_seo_title: Chapter 14 – Mysterious Liquid: Han Li Unlocks the Bottle's First Secret
chapter_meta_description: Han Li finally opens the mysterious bottle and finds a single drop of green liquid. A silver incentive from Doctor Mo reignites his cultivation drive. Four years pass, and Han Li reaches the third layer of the nameless formula.
og_title: Chapter 14: Mysterious Liquid – Han Li Opens the Bottle
og_description: A drop of emerald-green liquid appears inside the bottle after eight nights of absorbing light. Meanwhile, Doctor Mo discovers that doubling Han Li's silver is the key to motivating his cultivation.
twitter_title: Ch14: Bottle Opens, Green Liquid Appears
twitter_description: Han Li's persistence pays off as the bottle reveals its first secret. A simple bribe of silver gets him back to training. Four years bring him to the third layer.
